scope: Full reading of all eight EN/DE manuscripts, including supplied complete selected Chinese texts and translations, main arguments, every caption, optional reading, image/transcription/rights notes and references. Editorial proofreading and consistency review, not native-speaker human certification, new manuscript authentication, independent paleographic decipherment or image-rights clearance.

changes.details: Replaced the awkward phrase nichts gewöhnlich Weltliches with a direct rendering of 其書非世教: the books do not correspond to the teachings of this world. No line or argument omitted.

Follow-up clarifies two different orientation scales without moving the passage: the right-hand leaf of the third album opening is cropped in Figure 4; the 始制文字 passage is in the left pair of columns within that image.

preservation: Full supplied arguments, Chinese texts and translations, examples, image locators, optional readings, notes, references and rights statements retained. Received originals untouched. No image substitutions.
observations_for_parent: EP17 correctly distinguishes Zhiyong's calligraphic tradition from the 1109 engraving, the particular Song rubbing, album mounting and photography; its 88-character selection is explicitly not the complete Thousand-Character Classic.

EP18 retains attribution to Zhang Xu as an attribution, separates poetry authorship from the writing hand, and discloses manuscript/transmitted-poem variants and editorial corrections rather than silently normalizing them.
EP19 explicitly leaves precise 緜田 / 云肆 references unsettled and translates the final couplet conservatively; correction note and deletion marks remain distinct from a cleaned reading text.

EP20 retains one undeciphered character before 林, discloses its presence as ink rather than claiming damage, and does not guess a sobriquet. This language pass does not independently resolve that palaeographic question.
Publication-stage package/time wording remains in some rights notes; no absence-of-permission statement was removed or converted into an open licence.
